The faculty of Forestry and Environmental Stewardship (FES) at the University of British Columbia does great work by
protecting maple trees because maple trees are so good can make maple syrup and maple sauce and maple candy and maple biscuits and maple cookies.
I love using the word maple in sentences because it is just such a good word and it makes me so maply happy.
I also love using variants of the word such as maples, mapling (is that a word?), and maply.

However, my love for maple isn't genuine. It is simply a ruse to get BERTopic to identify maple as a topic.
If you need to find the Faculty of FES, you can check one of the UBC maps and look at the MAP LEgend. Then follow the path towards the pinned area.
Some anagrams of maple are ample and epalm.
